build_justification: The committed package scripts provide the production build: <https://github.com/Scetrov/frontier-flow/blob/main/package.json>.
contribution_requirements_justification: Required local quality checks are documented in <https://github.com/Scetrov/frontier-flow/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#22-local-quality-checks>.

delivery_mitm_justification: The application and source distribution channels use HTTPS: <https://frontier-flow.scetrov.live> and <https://github.com/Scetrov/frontier-flow>.
delivery_unsigned_justification: The only downloadable project artifacts are source releases served through GitHub HTTPS: https://github.com/Scetrov/frontier-flow.
description_good_justification: The project purpose is described at <https://github.com/Scetrov/frontier-flow/blob/main/README.md#frontier-flow>.
discussion_justification: Questions and proposals can be discussed publicly through <https://github.com/Scetrov/frontier-flow/issues> and pull requests.
documentation_basics_justification: The README documents the project, setup, use, tests, and contribution path: <https://github.com/Scetrov/frontier-flow/blob/main/README.md>.
documentation_interface_justification: The external input and output contracts for the visual graph, generated Move source, persistence formats, and external APIs are documented in https://github.com/Scetrov/frontier-flow/blob/main/docs/API-CONTRACTS.md.
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: The CI dynamic-analysis suites use Vitest and Playwright assertion-based tests: https://github.com/Scetrov/frontier-flow/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml.
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: Dynamic analysis is not applicable to this browser SPA.
dynamic_analysis_justification: CI applies Vitest component/integration tests and Playwright browser tests before changes merge: https://github.com/Scetrov/frontier-flow/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml.
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: The project is implemented in TypeScript and does not produce software in a memory-unsafe language.
english_justification: User and contributor documentation, issue templates, and the public issue tracker are in English: https://github.com/Scetrov/frontier-flow/blob/main/README.md and https://github.com/Scetrov/frontier-flow/issues.
enhancement_responses_justification: No enhancement requests were submitted in the last 12 months; the public issue search shows the complete period: https://github.com/Scetrov/frontier-flow/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20created%3A%3E%3D2025-07-25%20-label%3Abug.
floss_license_justification: Frontier Flow uses the OSI-approved MIT License: <https://github.com/Scetrov/frontier-flow/blob/main/LICENSE.md>.
floss_license_osi_justification: MIT is listed as an OSI-approved license: <https://opensource.org/license/mit>.
interact_justification: The README links users to contribution guidance and public issues at <https://github.com/Scetrov/frontier-flow/blob/main/README.md#contributing>.
know_common_errors_justification: Maintainer attestation: the primary developer receives annual OWASP Top 10 training and applies relevant vulnerability mitigations. Evidence record: https://github.com/Scetrov/frontier-flow/blob/main/SECURITY.md.
know_secure_design_justification: Maintainer attestation: the primary developer has regulated-industry secure-design experience, major-cloud certifications, and annual OWASP Top 10 training. Evidence record: https://github.com/Scetrov/frontier-flow/blob/main/SECURITY.md.
maintained_justification: The project has current commits and releases, including https://github.com/Scetrov/frontier-flow/releases/tag/v0.11.6 and https://github.com/Scetrov/frontier-flow/commits/main.
no_leaked_credentials_justification: Maintainer attestation: secret scanning and a repository-history scan found no leaked credentials or secrets. Evidence record: https://github.com/Scetrov/frontier-flow/blob/main/SECURITY.md.
release_notes_justification: Release notes are maintained in <https://github.com/Scetrov/frontier-flow/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md> and <https://github.com/Scetrov/frontier-flow/releases>.
release_notes_vulns_justification: Maintainer attestation: no publicly known run-time vulnerability with a CVE or similar identifier has been fixed in a Frontier Flow release; the human-readable release notes are published at https://github.com/Scetrov/frontier-flow/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md.
repo_distributed_justification: The project uses Git, a distributed version-control system, and publishes clone instructions in <https://github.com/Scetrov/frontier-flow/blob/main/README.md#getting-started>.
repo_interim_justification: The public pull-request history provides interim versions for review: <https://github.com/Scetrov/frontier-flow/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aclosed>.
repo_track_justification: The public Git repository exposes its commit history at <https://github.com/Scetrov/frontier-flow/commits/main/>.
report_archive_justification: Closed issues and their responses remain publicly searchable: <https://github.com/Scetrov/frontier-flow/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aclosed>.
report_process_justification: Users can submit bug reports through the public issue tracker: <https://github.com/Scetrov/frontier-flow/issues>.
report_responses_justification: The sole bug report in the last 12 months was acknowledged: https://github.com/Scetrov/frontier-flow/issues/19#issuecomment-4157908278.
sites_https_justification: The project website and repository use HTTPS: <https://frontier-flow.scetrov.live> and <https://github.com/Scetrov/frontier-flow>.
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: CodeQL analyzes the TypeScript/JavaScript codebase for common vulnerability patterns: https://github.com/Scetrov/frontier-flow/blob/main/.github/workflows/codeql.yml.
static_analysis_fixed_justification: Maintainer attestation: confirmed medium-or-higher exploitable static-analysis findings are fixed promptly; CodeQL is configured in https://github.com/Scetrov/frontier-flow/blob/main/.github/workflows/codeql.yml.
static_analysis_justification: CodeQL static analysis is configured for pushes, pull requests, and scheduled runs: <https://github.com/Scetrov/frontier-flow/blob/main/.github/workflows/codeql.yml>.
static_analysis_often_justification: CodeQL runs on pushes, pull requests, and a schedule: https://github.com/Scetrov/frontier-flow/blob/main/.github/workflows/codeql.yml.
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: CI runs unit tests with coverage and Playwright end-to-end tests on pushes and pull requests: https://github.com/Scetrov/frontier-flow/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml.
test_invocation_justification: The standard package scripts expose Vitest through `bun run test` and `bun run test:run`: https://github.com/Scetrov/frontier-flow/blob/main/package.json.
test_justification: The README documents the public automated test commands: <https://github.com/Scetrov/frontier-flow/blob/main/README.md#run-tests>.
test_most_justification: The unit suite enforces 70% line, branch, function, and statement coverage and CI also runs end-to-end tests: https://github.com/Scetrov/frontier-flow/blob/main/vite.config.ts.
test_policy_justification: Contributors must run linting, type checks, and unit tests before pushing: <https://github.com/Scetrov/frontier-flow/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#22-local-quality-checks>.
tests_are_added_justification: Recent major functionality includes automated tests: https://github.com/Scetrov/frontier-flow/pull/37/files.
tests_documented_added_justification: The contribution guide requires tests for new functionality and documents the expected test types: https://github.com/Scetrov/frontier-flow/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#6-adding-a-new-node-type.
version_semver_justification: The release runbook defines Semantic Versioning major, minor, and patch rules: https://github.com/Scetrov/frontier-flow/blob/main/docs/RELEASE-RUNBOOK.md#11-release-model.
version_tags_justification: Each release creates a v* Git tag and GitHub Release: https://github.com/Scetrov/frontier-flow/blob/main/docs/RELEASE-RUNBOOK.md#11-release-model.
version_unique_justification: Published releases provide unique project version identifiers: <https://github.com/Scetrov/frontier-flow/releases>.
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: Maintainer attestation: there are no known critical vulnerabilities in project code, and CI audits dependencies at high severity: https://github.com/Scetrov/frontier-flow/blob/main/SECURITY.md.
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: Maintainer attestation: no publicly known vulnerabilities exist in the project results. Evidence record: https://github.com/Scetrov/frontier-flow/blob/main/SECURITY.md.
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: Private GitHub Security Advisory reporting is documented at <https://github.com/Scetrov/frontier-flow/blob/main/SECURITY.md#reporting-a-vulnerability>.
vulnerability_report_process_justificati: The security policy provides the vulnerability-reporting process: <https://github.com/Scetrov/frontier-flow/blob/main/SECURITY.md#reporting-a-vulnerability>.
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: Maintainer attestation: no vulnerability reports were received in the last six months.
warnings_fixed_justification: Maintainer attestation: confirmed medium-or-higher compiler and linter warnings are fixed promptly. Evidence record: https://github.com/Scetrov/frontier-flow/blob/main/SECURITY.md.
warnings_justification: CI runs Oxlint to detect code-quality errors: <https://github.com/Scetrov/frontier-flow/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml>.
warnings_strict_justification: Oxlint uses type-aware analysis and treats its correctness, TypeScript, React, and accessibility rules as errors: https://github.com/Scetrov/frontier-flow/blob/main/.oxlintrc.json.
